title: Lesson map
description: A wide road with a gold centre line is drawn across the whole screen (GSAP DrawSVG, a runner on MotionPath) and four to seven stops light up as the line arrives: a picture card, the lesson, its title and its tool. One stop is "now" and is gold. On a slide two stops come per click; on a web page the screen stays pinned and the scroll draws the road; on a phone the road runs down the side.

props.stops: required, 4-7 of {when, title, tool, src, alt}: when = small caps (Lesson 2), tool = small mono line, src = picture of the result (a numbered circle without it)
props.now: which stop is gold, counted from 1
props.title: short heading, 2-5 words
props.click: false = the whole road in one go on a slide (default: two stops per click)
